entities.name: Neferkare Khendu

entities.summary: Neferkare Khendu was an ancient Egyptian king of the Eighth Dynasty during the early First Intermediate Period. According to the Egyptologists Kim Ryholt, Jürgen Beckerath, and Darrell Baker, he was the sixth king of the Eighth Dynasty.
